instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Terminal / Mission Control aesthetic. Avoid pure black (#000000) - use zinc-950 (#09090B) for the deepest backgrounds.
Use 'Chivo' for headings, 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text, and 'IBM Plex Mono' for all numerical data, IDs, timestamps, and status badges. Include these from Google Fonts.

Implement the Operations Board Kanban with 14 columns: Booked->Assigned->Dispatched->Pickup Started->At Pickup->Loaded->In Transit->At Delivery->Delivered->Docs Pending->Invoice Pending->Payment Pending->Closed->At Risk. Ensure horizontal scrolling works smoothly.
The Load Execution Page must be a dense 'single pane of glass' with a timeline, quick actions, map, weather, and risks.
All numerical columns in tables must be right-aligned for clean readability.
Apply 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, row actions). Format MUST be 'role-action-descriptor'.
For critical alerts, use red borders with a subtle animate-pulse effect.
DO NOT use generic Shadcn Card padding (p-6) everywhere; override it to p-3 or p-4 for higher data density to match the terminal aesthetic.
Build the 19-item sidebar. Active states should use a subtle lighter zinc background.
The UI is a React application using Tailwind CSS. Ensure components are cleanly extracted and heavily reuse the defined typography classes.
DO NOT use Inter or Roboto anywhere in the UI.
